autoEscape.zh-CN: 是否自动转义 searchWords 中的正则特殊字符。
autoEscape.en-US: Whether to escape regular expression characters in searchWords.

classNames.zh-CN: 高亮标签的类名，键为 highlight，值的写法同 class（字符串、数组或对象），与组件自带的类名合并；`searchWords` 项自带的 class 追加在其后。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the highlight tag, keyed by highlight; values take anything class takes (string, array or object) and merge with the built-in classes. The class of a `searchWords` item is appended after them.

component.en-US: Tag name of the highlight element.

searchWords.zh-CN: 需要高亮的文本：字符串、字符串数组，或带 text、class、style 的对象数组。
searchWords.en-US: Text to highlight: a string, a string array, or an array of objects with text, class and style.

styles.zh-CN: 高亮标签的样式字符串，键为 highlight；`searchWords` 项自带的 style 叠加在其后。
styles.en-US: Style string of the highlight tag, keyed by highlight. The style of a `searchWords` item is applied after it.
